question: Sultan Iltutmish introduced a metal coin named Jital which was made of:
solution:
The Correct Answer is **__Copper.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Metal coin Name **Jital **wahich was made of **Copper.**
 
• The Tanka and Jital were introduced by the Delhi Sultan Rule Named **Sultan Iltutmish.**
 
• Tanka was a **silver coin**.
 
• During the reign of the ninth ruler of the Mamluk dynasty,** Balban**, **gold Tankas** were issued.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
